description: Client-side script for 'Loan' form in ERPNext, managing loan operations, UI interactions, and server calls.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for the Loan form, defining make methods.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Actions to perform when the form loads, including setting queries and ignoring certain doctypes.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the form, adds custom buttons based on loan status.

methods.name: loan_type
methods.description: Handles changes to loan type, toggling related fields.

methods.name: make_loan_disbursement
methods.description: Initiates loan disbursement process via server call.

methods.name: make_repayment_entry
methods.description: Creates a repayment entry for the loan.

methods.name: request_loan_closure
methods.description: Requests closure of the loan after user confirmation.

methods.name: loan_application
methods.description: Fetches and applies data from a linked loan application.

methods.name: repayment_method
methods.description: Handles changes to repayment method, toggling related fields.

methods.name: toggle_fields
methods.description: Enables or displays fields based on current form data.
